create_model_interaction: create a model interaction using CreateModelInteractionParams with model name and input content
create_agent_interaction: create an agent interaction using CreateAgentInteractionParams with agent name and input content
parse_streaming_events: parse streaming SSE events using InteractionSSEEvent discriminator on event_type field
